name: Home Assistant
author: DockHub
description: The state of a Home Assistant entity, such as a temperature or a door. Click a light, switch or fan to turn it on or off.

settings.label: Home Assistant address
settings.description: For example http://homeassistant.local:8123 or your https address.

settings.label: Long-lived access token
settings.description: Create one in Home Assistant under your profile › Security. Stored in DockHub's settings on this PC.

settings.label: Entity
settings.description: Its entity id, for example sensor.living_room_temperature or light.desk.
